# Opal Pettigrew

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)</sub>
- **Role:** student  <sub>[v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

Opal is a striking and beautiful young woman with a full, eye-catching figure, radiant skin, and big, vivid blue eyes. She wears a lengthy blonde plait, which she styles up while in town and lets down at home. She is noted for her vigor, healthy complexion, and general good looks, being considered the most beautiful girl at the Regent's Academy.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Personality

Opal possesses a sunny and pleasant disposition, laughs frequently, and thoroughly enjoys life. She is preoccupied with romance, beaus, and suitors, often expressing dramatic sentimentality in her creative writing. However, she is prone to hysterics and weeping during distressing or terrifying situations.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 c23 P16](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0016), [v1 c26 P6](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0006), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c28 P36](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0036), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)_

## Goals

- to get a boyfriend upon turning fifteen  <sub>[v1 c26 P5](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0005)</sub>
- to drive a group of suitors wild once reaching adulthood  <sub>[v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015)</sub>
- to teach for two years post-qualification and then marry  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## History

While attending Brierley school, Opal once had her long plait tied to her chair by Hugh Carrow, causing her to scream and weep in front of the class when she stood up. Despite frequently claiming to detest her teacher Mr. Pidgeon, she broke into tears during his parting address, sparking a chain reaction of crying among her female classmates. At a gathering, she successfully scaled a large willow tree on a challenge from Carrie Mott despite fearing caterpillars and damaging her dress. During an outing at a pond with her friends, she refused to play dead on a floating craft due to her fears, collapsed into hysterics when Nell Harcourt had an accident, and expressed concern that drama-acting was sinful. Later, she went on to attend the Regent's Academy to train as a teacher, often walking home with Hugh carrying her bag.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 c23 P5](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0005), [v1 c23 P16](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0016), [v1 c28 P1](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0001), [v1 c28 P13](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0013), [v1 c28 P36](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0036), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)_
